format: TypeScript (TSX for React-like JSX syntax with Qwik framework)
description: This is a source file for a frontend web application implementing a multiplayer Tic Tac Toe game using the Qwik framework. It manages game state, user interactions, real-time updates via polling, and UI rendering.
